audience: HR teams that use Hailey HR for employees, time off and reported time

useCases.title: Review the company structure
useCases.text: Read the departments, locations, teams, titles, legal entities and cost centers of the company.

useCases.title: List employees and their employments
useCases.text: List employees with status, department, location, manager and joining date. Read the employments with start and end dates.

useCases.title: Check time off for a period
useCases.text: List time off for the company, filtered by a from date and a to date. The result includes each employee's entries.

useCases.title: Check reported time for a period
useCases.text: List the time employees reported for a date range. Without a range, the current month is used.

useCases.title: Read open job ads
useCases.text: List the job ads with title, description, publish dates, location and department.
